title: Parking License Enforcement Figures — Warnings, Fines and Tows
content:
Community parking rules, schedule of enforcement figures. The same figures apply to every Parking License product.

| Figure | Surface Unreserved Permit | Surface Reserved Space | Covered Carport Space | Structured Garage Space | EV Charging Reserved Space | Private Detached Garage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Warnings for a non-emergency violation before fines start (trailing 365 days) | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Violation fine amount per non-emergency violation after the warnings | $50.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 |
| Fines within the trailing 365 days after which the next non-emergency violation is towed | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Hours a notice is posted on an inoperable or abandoned vehicle before towing | 72 | 72 | 72 | 72 | 72 | 72 |
| Days a vehicle may stay unmoved before it is treated as abandoned | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 | 14 |

## Violations towed on the first occurrence

On every product, two violation codes are towed on their first occurrence:

- a **fire lane** violation;
- a **blocking access** violation.

All other violations are non-emergency violations for the purposes of the figures above.
